description: FR-SALES-004 -- Pricing & Discounts: one item's price on one list.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: Pricing & Discounts -- the item being priced

fields.label: Price List
fields.description: Pricing & Discounts -- the list this price belongs to

fields.label: UOM
fields.description: UOM Master -- the unit the rate is per

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Pricing & Discounts -- price per unit. For a main product this is worked out: material cost plus margin.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency Master -- copied from the price list

fields.label: Raw Material Prices From
fields.description: The buying list the raw materials' prices are read from. Left empty, the default buying list is used.

fields.label: Material Cost
fields.description: Each raw material's price times its count, added up. Worked out again on its own whenever one of those prices changes.

fields.label: Margin Type
fields.description: Percentage of the material cost, or a fixed amount added to it.

fields.label: Margin
fields.description: Added to the material cost to give the rate.

fields.label: Raw Materials Without a Price
fields.description: These have no price on the list above, so they add nothing to the material cost. Price them and this product is repriced.

fields.label: Valid From
fields.description: Pricing & Discounts -- when this price takes effect

name: KNIT 360 Item Price
